subject: Request: 30-day pilot extension + supplemental credits for Oxygen.ai
messages:
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@oxygen.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@oxygen.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot usage + ask for short extension and credits

Hi Olga & Ben,

Thanks again for the support during week one of the pilot. Integration hit a couple of snags on our side (data mapping + a 3rd-party transform), which has slowed ingestion and end-to-end testing. Our engineers estimate ~75% of expected inference volume has actually run through the system.

We have two asks so we can get a representative evaluation:
- 30-day extension to the pilot window (to complete the remaining tests and run the long-tail prompts)
- $15k in supplemental credits to cover the additional token usage we'll generate while validating the safety and latency profiles

Attached is our usage report and a quick note from our engineering lead on the technical blockers. We think the full evaluation will materially increase the chance of a committed deal next quarter (we discussed a potential 12–18 month commit in our last call).

Can you confirm whether Ox can get both the time and credits? If there are other options (smaller credit + extension + commit), happy to discuss. Procurement is looped in.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Director of Product
Oxygen.ai

Attachments: oxygen_trial_usage_report.pdf
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot usage + ask for short extension and credits

Forwarding Samantha's request — Oxygen.ai is asking for an exception beyond our standard 14-day auto-extensions and beyond the typical $5k courtesy top-up. Key context:
- Likely ARR if they convert: ~$360k/year (sales estimates).
- They've had an integration delay on their side; nothing platform-related.
- Procurement is asking for a single answer (time + credits) so they can finalize the evaluation calendar.

My recommendation to avoid losing momentum: approve a one-time 30-day extension + $12.5k in credits, conditional on:
1) Signed SOW or PO agreeing to purchase/commit conversation within 30 days of extension end
2) Credits are one-time, non-recoupable, and capped to token usage for pilot evaluation only
3) Finance to mark credits as marketing/enablement (not a billing waiver) — we need this classification for ARR forecasting

Ben — can you confirm whether Legal/Finance will accept the conditional language? If so I can draft the approval email to Samantha and include the DocuSign link for the SOW.

Thanks,
Olga
Senior Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot usage + ask for short extension and credits

Thanks for the context, Olga. I agree we should avoid killing momentum — Oxygen.ai is a high-quality prospect and the ARR math supports a modest concession. A couple of notes from Finance/Legal after a quick sync:

- Finance: We can categorize up to $12.5k as sales enablement credits without impacting the booked ARR. Anything above that becomes a pricing concession and will need Sales Ops approval. Also, credits must be timeboxed and flagged in the billing system as "Pilot - Oxygen.ai".
- Legal: We need the one-time credit usage clause in the SOW and a clause that credits expire if not used during the extension window. Also want to ensure we reserve the right to throttle if abusive patterns appear.

Proposal (safe middle ground):
- Approve 30-day extension
- Approve $12,500 in supplemental credits (one-time, pilot-only, expires at extension end)
- Require signed SOW or PO within 30 days after extension ends to unlock any further concessions

Marissa — can you please sign off on the final approval? If you’re good with the wording Ben suggested we can send a short approval note to Samantha and attach the SOW for signature. I can also set up the billing labels and the usage cap.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Commercial Lead, EMEA & US
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@redwood.ai, legal@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Oxygen.ai one-time concession

Thanks team — good summary. I approve the one-time concession with the conditions Ben outlined. Finalized here for the record and for Olga to communicate back to Oxygen.ai:

Approved concession (one-time exception):
- 30-day pilot extension starting 2027-04-12
- $12,500 supplemental credits applied to the Oxygen.ai pilot account, marked as "Pilot - Oxygen.ai", expiring at the end of the extension window
- Credits are non-recoupable and limited to evaluation usage only; any production usage or overage will be billed normally
- Requirement: Signed SOW or PO for a purchase discussion (minimum purchase target to be discussed per Sales) must be submitted within 30 days after the extension ends; failure to submit will forfeit eligibility for further concessions
- Legal to include credit expiry and abuse/usage protections in the SOW; Finance to label the credit and ensure correct IFRS/ARR treatment

Olga — please send the approval to Samantha and attach the proposed SOW (use the DocuSign link below). Copy Procurement so they have the timeline and billing notes.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
